apps.description: Pocket DM is a two-player storytelling game on one Android phone. Each player invents an improbable character, then takes turns describing what they try next. The game turns each move into a narrated comic and keeps the consequences fair. It is an early prototype: practice mode works offline, and live storytelling uses your own OpenAI key.
features: Describe a character's identity, personality and looks
Speak or type your move, then read the comic
Private secrets and handoffs on a shared phone
Spoken commentary with an offline voice or your own provider
Resume saved encounters and reuse character art

apps.name: Close Call
apps.changelog: One RykerSoft sign-in connects YouTube search and Pro answer judging, with no API keys to enter
apps.tagline: A family guessing game with picture, video and song clues.
apps.description: Close Call is a guessing game for two or three players on one phone, made for Ryker, Nemo and Ender. Take turns setting clues, then race to recognise them: pictures zoom out from a close-up, videos play muted with sealed guesses, and songs use hold-to-speak buzzers.
features: Picture clues that reveal along a timed zoom
Muted video clues with private, sealed guesses
Song rounds with buzzers and bonus points for artist and album
Free answer matching with no account
apps.pro: Pro adds YouTube search for clues and AI judging of uncertain answers.

apps.tagline: Turn your photos into memes, then remix what the community makes.
apps.description: MechaMeme turns your photos into editable memes. Import a photo, generate and revise captions for free, and adjust the text and placement yourself. Keep a private library on your device, browse the Community feed, upvote what you like and remix any post into your own take.
features: Free caption generation with styles and directions
Crop photos and edit caption text and placement
A Community feed with upvotes and emoji reactions
Remix any Community image without signing in
A private library with versions you can swipe through
Export PNGs or .meme files that stay editable
apps.pro: Pro adds Recreate me, which generates a new scene from your photo. Captions, editing and Community are free.

apps.tagline: An ear-training game across a sky campaign: notes, intervals, chords and more.
apps.description: Earbound teaches your ear to recognise notes, intervals, chords, inversions, scales, modes and progressions. Play a 480-match campaign across eight sectors of the sky, learn with short hands-on lessons, practise in a studio you can customise, or play with friends. Everything runs on your phone: no account, no subscription, and no connection needed for solo play.
features: A 480-match campaign across eight sectors
28 hands-on lessons, suggested from your own mix-ups
Placement matches, so experienced listeners skip ahead
A practice studio with 17 exercises and ten difficulty levels
Answer by tapping, on a piano keyboard or by voice
More than 100 achievements and detailed records
Party play for 2 to 8 on the same Wi-Fi, or pass the phone
